payload.report_excerpt: The scaling literature has settled the question of emergence: capabilities appear discontinuously once a model crosses a predictable parameter threshold, and the threshold can be read off the loss curve in advance [Farrow, 2021].
payload.source_excerpt: We fit cross-entropy loss as a power law in parameters, dataset size and compute over seven orders of magnitude. The fits are smooth and we observe no discontinuity in loss at any scale we tested. We make no claim about downstream task metrics, which we did not measure.
